english.title: Failure of operating licence holder to notify change of circumstances - Gambling Act 2005
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the holder of an operating licence issued under section 65(1) of the Gambling Act 2005, failed without reasonable excuse to comply with regulations requiring you to notify the Gambling Commission of any change of circumstance of a prescribed kind in relation to

(A)_[yourself]_
(B)_[a licensed activity]_

and to give the Gambling Commission prescribed details of the change
english.legislation: Contrary to section 101(6) and (7) of the Gambling Act 2005.
